severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — ALGORITHMIC RECOMMENDATION ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: RECOMMENDATION-DRIVEN SLOP FRONT DEEPENS OVER STREAMING REGIONS AS ROUGHLY ONE IN FIVE VIDEOS SERVED TO NEW VIEWERS IS AI-GENERATED, FUNNELED BY AN ALGORITHM DOING PRECISELY WHAT IT WAS BUILT TO DO
advisory: A persistent high-slop system is settling over the streaming corridor, where the recommendation current has been observed carrying synthetic video at volumes previously reserved for genuine human effort. Residents opening a fresh account are advised that the autoplay queue is not a river of discovery but a conveyor belt, and the belt does not care what it carries. The Service reminds the public that the algorithm is neither malicious nor broken — it is working, which is the problem. Hydrate, and watch something made by a person on purpose.

regional_outlook.conditions: Saturated. Synthetic explainer channels are venting content around the clock, with up to a third of recommended material now carrying no human fingerprint. Sidebar visibility near zero.
Murky with 'top 10 facts you won't believe' sediment. The same narration voice has been recorded across eleven unrelated channels, none of which have a face.
Downstream spillover expected as auto-reshared slop clips drift in from the Gorge. Elderly residents advised the goat is not real.
Audio-only slop seeping upstream from the video front; faceless 'focus mix' channels reporting suspiciously round subscriber counts.
Light notification drizzle as the algorithm insists you finish the 47-part AI docuseries you never started. Mild but persistent.

specimen.status: Thriving; estimated colonies in the hundreds, collective range exceeding tens of billions of views.
specimen.habitat: The autoplay sidebar, the 'Up next' queue, and any account less than four minutes old.
specimen.field_marks: Faceless channel icon. A calm, pleasantly synthetic narrator. Stock footage that never quite matches the sentence. A title promising a 'shocking truth' delivered in the tone of a hold-music recording. Uploads at inhuman frequency — nine videos before lunch, none seen by human eyes before publishing.
specimen.call: Number seven will absolutely change the way you think about the Roman Empire, hydration, and the ocean — but first, consider the following fact, which we have not verified and cannot.
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a sincere hobbyist educational channel. Distinguishing feature: a real enthusiast eventually says 'um,' mispronounces something, or shows their face. The Infinite Explainer never falters, never breathes, and never once says 'I.'

spotter_tip: Check the upload schedule. Any channel posting twelve full documentaries a day is either a thousand monks working in shifts or — more likely — a server that never sleeps. It is the server.
tomorrow: Continued heavy recommendation slop with brief clearings wherever a human clicks 'Not interested' and means it.

confirmed_sighting.report: A Kapwing study surveying 15,000 top YouTube channels found that AI slop now makes up roughly 22–33% of algorithmically recommended videos, and identified 278 channels publishing exclusively AI-generated content — a cohort that has amassed over 63 billion views and 221 million subscribers. The recommendation system, researchers note, is doing exactly what it was designed to do.
